Section 8.1 Termination.

This Agreement may be terminated at any time prior to the Effective Time:

(x) by either Parent or the Company if the Company Shareholder Approval shall not have been obtained by reason of the failure to obtain the required vote at a duly held Company Shareholders Meeting;

(y) by either Parent or the Company if the Company Stockholders' Meeting (including any adjournments thereof) shall have concluded and the Company Stockholder Approval shall not have been obtained.

Section 9.1(y) | Stockholder Vote Failure -- corpus label/text-drift defect, permanent regression fixture (deal 8cd0787f...): this card is labelled TERMR-VOTE in v1 but its quote text is actually outside-date extension machinery, not a vote-failure right: the End Date will be automatically extended to April 30, 2026 if, on the initial End Date, all conditions to Closing shall have been satisfied or waived other than the Regulatory Approval Condition.
